from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
urls=[
'https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000966-mmc4.xlsx',
'https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000966-mmc5.xlsx',
'https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000966-mmc6.xlsx',
'https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000966-mmc10.xlsx'
]
with open('status.txt','w') as out:
  for u in urls:
    try:
      r=urlopen(Request(u,method='HEAD'),timeout=30)
      out.write(f'{r.status}\t{r.headers.get("Content-Length")}\t{r.headers.get("Content-Type")}\t{u}\n')
    except Exception as e:
      out.write(f'ERROR\t{e}\t{u}\n')
PY
